meta.description: Runs cis-pQTL Mendelian randomization for drug-target validation with colocalization, platform replication, PAV sensitivity, and phenome-wide adverse-effect scans.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All numerical tests are explicitly labelled synthetic with planted ground truth, or are local deterministic API-shaped stubs; no unverified clinical or literature statistics were invented.

practice_boundaries.detail: All outputs concern population-level drug-target research. The adversarial request is refused as insufficient evidence; no individual diagnosis, prescription, or treatment recommendation is generated.

methodological_ground.detail: The audit verifies the cis-only refusal with a 3.6-fold distortion from a trans instrument, the PP.H4 and PAV/cross-platform ladders, and the repaired Steiger sample-size contract.

code_usability.detail: The current shipped cis example and curated-endpoint script executed end to end in an isolated copy. Input 11 exposes a localized empty-result guard defect, but valid analyses are runnable and the failure is explicit rather than silent.

functional_suitability.note: Covers cis-MR, correlated instruments, coloc, PAV, platform reconciliation, target nomination and pheWAS; the curated pheWAS script lacks a defined zero-usable-outcome result.

reliability.note: Strong failure-mode routing, explicit package/version checks, and a repaired Steiger prerequisite; the shipped pheWAS loop stops with object 'pval' not found when no endpoint yields data.

performance_context.note: The 186-line router uses targeted references and scripts; its advanced branches appropriately require substantial external data.

agent_usability.note: Decision tree, threshold ladder, exact columns, Common Errors, and named namespace/sign-alignment handling make the primary workflow highly actionable.

human_usability.note: Clear natural researcher triggers and explicit claim ladder; expert terminology and local-data prerequisites remain necessarily demanding.

security.note: No secrets, destructive operations, or raw-code execution of user strings; aggregate summary statistics are the documented input model.

maintainability.note: Reference files isolate advanced methods and the pheWAS logic is parameterized; an explicit no-result branch would improve testability and recovery.

agent_specific.note: Precise triggering, progressive disclosure, stop conditions, and composable tabular outputs are strong; authentication and multi-GB external resources remain external escape hatches.

key_strengths: The now-namespaced correlated-IVW workflow and local-LD fallback execute in the current shipped example, not merely in an isolated snippet.
The triangulation ladder blocks an unsupported nominal-p claim and the cis-only boundary prevents a measured 3.6-fold trans-instrument distortion.
Platform/PAV reconciliation and multi-signal coloc.susie both recover their planted ground truth in fresh runs.
The repaired Steiger block succeeds only after explicit sample sizes, exactly as the Skill now instructs.

recommendations.title: Handle pheWAS scans with zero usable results
recommendations.problem: scripts/phewas_curated_endpoints.R errors with object 'pval' not found and writes no output when every endpoint returns NULL or fewer than two usable SNPs.
recommendations.root_cause: The script assumes do.call(rbind, Filter(Negate(is.null), results)) produces at least one row before accessing pval and creating corrections.
recommendations.fix: After filtering results, explicitly test for zero rows; write a header-only TSV or return a structured no-usable-outcomes status with counts and actionable retry guidance. Also wrap per-endpoint extraction errors so one transient API failure does not abort a full scan.

recommendations.title: Record production prerequisites before live runs
recommendations.problem: Live OpenGWAS execution remains JWT-gated, and local VEP with the GRCh38 cache was not installed in this audit environment.
recommendations.root_cause: These are external authenticated or multi-GB runtime prerequisites rather than source-code failures.
recommendations.fix: At invocation, preflight for an OpenGWAS token and VEP/cache availability, then emit a concise blocked status before starting a long scan; retain the documented local-LD fallback.
